periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward tilt relative to the horizontal axis extending from the rostrum to the pinna.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a width-to-height ratio of approximately 1:1.8.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering with the inferior boundary extending closer to the maxillary region than the superior boundary is to the cranial crest.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior margin of the dark band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad band, comprising approximately 40% of the visible torso length from the neck to the mid-abdomen.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature on the primary visible left ear.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly textured, prominent guard hairs on the cranial surface creating a 'spiky' appearance along the sagittal plane.
